crossRefs.note: For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb…
Then the children of Judah came near to Joshua in Gilgal. Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, “You…

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Faithful spy, given Hebron as inheritance

people.name: Jephunneh
people.line: The Kenizzite, father of Caleb the spy.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.
translations.bsb: Of those men who had gone to spy out the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive.
translations.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived
translations.asv: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men that went to spy out the land.
